checks.command: sh -c 'for d in packages/*/ packages/*/*/ examples/*/; do if [ -f "$d/tsconfig.json" ]; then if [ -f "$d/package.json" ] && grep -q "\"typecheck\"" "$d/package.json"; then if grep -q "packages/tooling/tsc/dist/bin.cjs" "$d/package.json" && [ ! -f packages/tooling/tsc/dist/bin.cjs ]; then ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p "$d" || true; else (cd "$d" && bun run typecheck) || exit 1; fi; else ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p "$d" || exit 1; fi; fi; done'
